purpose: Document first-party Asahikawa registry/map discovery, archive schema inspection, and bounded anonymous geometry-access attempts.
assessment: Official municipal reference-map publication and public GIS are evidenced. The 2025 archive was downloaded and its polygon schema inspected, but the bounded unchanged-WUP-point query returned zero features and the publisher disclaims authoritative boundary/legal use. No GeoJSON sample was retained.
registryAssessment: Local municipal data custody is evidenced by the Asahikawa City Asset Tax Division download page and Asahikawa Digital Map. The Legal Affairs Bureau is separately evidenced as the registry-map custodian/procedure context. This is not source admission or runtime integration.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Asahikawa City publishes 2025-01-01 地番参考図 and 路線価図 as GIS shapefile ZIP downloads; it warns that 地番参考図 is not a 公図 and does not prove boundary, exact position/shape, or rights.
Official Asahikawa Digital Map public GIS portal; the portal advertises 地番参考図 and 地籍調査成果 map updates.
Official city explanation of 地籍調査, 地籍図/地籍簿, and forwarding completed results to the Legal Affairs Bureau.
Official Asahikawa Legal Affairs Bureau notice for current map-making projects in Asahikawa Kagura districts.
